subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — scheduling and timezone lock
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@springboardai.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing — scheduling and timezone lock

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap so we’re aligned on scope before we lock a sizing deep dive:

- Workload profile: real-time chat + occasional batch rerank
- Peak concurrency target: ~120 concurrent requests (burst to 180)
- Typical sequence length: ~512 tokens (P95 ~ 700 for long-turns)
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms end-to-end (including network)
- Model: customer will test with an open-llama-variant (65B) quantized; plan to run with KV cache enabled
- Daily token volume estimate: ~50M tokens/day

Next step: schedule the dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) so our Solutions Engineering team can size GPU pool and validate autoscale/burst settings. Proposed 1-hour slots (all listed with PT / ET):

- Tue Nov 16: 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Wed Nov 17: 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET
- Wed Nov 17: 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET

Please let us know which slot works best and who from your side should join (we recommend a technical owner + SRE). For prep, attached is a small preload_profile we use to model throughput and a short capacity questionnaire — if you can return that before the call it will speed things up.

Attendees from our side (tentative):
- Irene Choi (Solutions Engineering) — will lead the sizing run-through
- Ben Carter (Account Executive) — procurement/contract questions
- myself — discovery follow-ups and next steps

Action items:
- Alex: confirm preferred slot + add any other attendees
- Alex: return the attached preload CSV and answer the short questionnaire if possible
- Priyom/Irene: we’ll send a calendar invite once time is confirmed and include an agenda + test harness link

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
[attachment: springboard_preload_profile_v2.csv (text/csv)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@springboardai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@springboardai.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — scheduling and timezone lock

Priyom —

Appreciate the clear recap. We’d like to take the Wed Nov 17 slot, 11:00–12:00 ET (that lines up with your Wed 08:00–09:00 PT slot). Emma Liu (Lead SRE) will join to walk through our load shaping and deployment constraints.

A few quick notes from our side to make the deep dive productive:
- Our test harness will include a representative 10k request sample (we’ll trim to high-variance flows) — expect 60–90 second long-turn examples in a small subset
- We still need to confirm whether we’ll allow model sharding in the test environment; Emma will clarify on the call
- Procurement: we’re aiming to finalize a PO in the same week, but need a high-level cost estimate (ballpark per-hour) to scope internal approvals

I’m attaching a small CSV (preload_profile) with our observed token distribution and a short note about peak hour distribution.

HubSpot ref: HS-98765 — I’ll link the calendar invite there.

If Wed Nov 17 11:00–12:00 ET is confirmed from your side, I’ll accept the calendar invite and forward to our Platform lead.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Director, Technical Operations — Springboard AI
alex.turner@springboardai.com
[attachment: springboard_preload_profile_v2.csv (text/csv)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@springboardai.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing — scheduling and timezone lock

Alex —

Thanks — Wed Nov 17 08:00–09:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET is locked on our side. I’ve gone ahead and created the calendar invite and included the agenda and the shared test harness link. Irene will run the sizing checklist and we’ll prepare a rough per-hour estimate for dedicated pool sizing so you have a number for procurement. Ben will follow up on SOW/PO timing and any contract questions.

Agenda (30–45 minute technical + 15 minute procurement/next steps):
1) Quick recap of expected traffic patterns and token distributions (you)
2) Sizing run using preload_profile (Irene)
3) Latency/throughput trade-offs and autoscale policy recommendations (Irene + Priyom)
4) Procurement ask: ballpark cost and next steps (Ben)
5) Action items and timeline to get a staging run scheduled

Attachments: I’m including the Redwood capacity questionnaire (redwood_capacity_questionnaire.pdf) — if you can drop answers into the doc before the call, that will speed the conversation.

See you on Nov 17.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
